svg.text: tray root pad to the shoulder
1. Fit the flange tray over the collar so the flats engage its keyed socket, then tighten item 4 with the two-jaw driver. Threadlocker
candidate: Loctite 243. Torque not yet set.
2. Seat item 3 dry in the body gland. Thread item 2 on until the shoulders meet. The metal faces, not the O-ring, carry the closure.
Body, nose cap, nose O-ring and rear nut
